title: American Revolution
paras: The American Revolution (1765–1789) was a political movement in the Thirteen Colonies of Great Britain. It began as a colonial rebellion and evolved into a revolution, the result of which was the creation of the United States following the colonies' victory in the American Revolutionary War (1775–1783) and British recognition of their sovereign independence in the Treaty of Paris. The Second Continental Congress, as the provisional government, established the Continental Army and appointed George Washington as its commander-in-chief in 1775. In May 1776, Congress voted to suppress all forms of Crown authority, to be replaced by locally created authority, and each state created a constitution. The Congress passed the Lee Resolution for independence on July 2 and unanimously adopted the Declaration of Independence on July 4 arguing for the separation based on "inalienable rights". The individual member states together created a shared sovereignty under the Articles of Confederation to facilitate international affairs and the promulgation of the war. Throughout most of the conflict the outcome appeared uncertain, but a decisive 1781 victory by combined French and Continental Army forces commanded by Washington in the Siege of Yorktown led King George III and the Fox–North coalition in government to negotiate the cessation of British colonial rule, and the acknowledgment of American sovereignty. A more centralized federal republic was created with the passage of the Constitution of the United States that took effect in 1789, and the Bill of Rights was ratified in 1791.
